entries.en: Stupid krogan. No wonder his kind ran themselves into the ground.
You can't reason with krogan. We've known that for a thousand years.
This mission is too important to get bogged down by one krogan.
I thought we were almost done with krogan. What's it take to get rid of them?
I'm surprised that krogan yielded to your argument.
Watch that krogan of yours. Who knows what he'll do once you're in the breeding chambers.
I've been on this mission far too long. My brood won't even recognize me.
The captain knows we will follow him anywhere. To the very end.
We're not known for direct combat, but that may work in our favor. The geth won't know our tactics.
I don't even want to imagine what will happen if we don't destroy this facility.
I really hope the Council pays attention to what's happening here.
The captain has never let us down, and never will.
The geth will not know how to address our assault. This is a unique action for our team.
Destroying this facility is all that matters. We are all expendable in pursuit of that goal.
The krogan certainly are persistent. Not in a good way.
Sometimes I wonder if the krogan are trying to get themselves killed.
We can't let the krogan cancer spread again.
This mess will only get bigger. Unless we stop it.
You talked sense to a krogan. I didn't think that was possible.
I don't mind a krogan at our side. It's behind and in front that concerns me.
It won't be an easy fight, but we're ready when you are.
I hope these salarians can fight.
Just say the word. I'm ready to go.
I'd rather have Wrex on our side, but he chose his path.
I don't like the looks Wrex keeps throwing at you. Watch yourself.
This is what we trained for. Saren won't know what hit him.
Nice job with Wrex. He's totally changed his attitude.
I'm ready when you are, Commander.
If you need my help dealing with Wrex, just let me know.
With any luck, we'll catch Saren with his guard down.
Normally, I wouldn't think much of salarians in a fire fight, but these soldiers seem well-trained.
You did the right thing with Wrex. He could've jeopardized the whole mission.
I'm concerned about Wrex. Can we still trust him?
Looks like the Council screwed up yet again.
With all these defenses, Saren must be hiding something big.
I can't believe you were able to calm Wrex down.
I'm ready when you are, Commander. Just say the word.
The last thing we need is an angry krogan on our team.
I can't believe we've found Saren's base of operations, and the Council doesn't even know about it.
I guess we're stuck here for now.
These salarians seem pretty tough. I just hope they hold up under pressure.
We're close, Commander. Saren can't hide forever.
Nice work with Wrex. I didn't think anything would calm him down.
I'm ready to go when you are, Commander.
I don't like the way Wrex is behaving. He's really on edge.
Whatever you need, Commander. I'll be right behind you.
Whatever you need, Commander. I'm right behind you.
It's really too bad Wrex couldn't be reasoned with.
Be careful with Wrex. He's not himself.
This won't be easy, but it's what we train for.
This facility is well protected. It must be very important to Saren.
These salarians are some of the best-trained anywhere. We will need their help.
Your ability to calm the krogan is impressive.
Wrex's fate was regrettable, but inevitable, given the circumstances.
I am worried that Wrex's allegiance to you may be waning.
I can only imagine what we will find in Saren's facility.
Taking the facility will not be easy, but I am sure we will succeed.
We will be a better team without Wrex. His loyalties could not be trusted.
The krogan's demeanor is worrying.
Saren may be mad, but he is not stupid. We will not get to him without a fight.
If we fail, no one will hear of this. If we succeed, same result.
The captain has our complete support. He will see us through.
We will surprise everyone. Infiltration is not our only skill.
This facility must be destroyed.
The krogan never change, never adapt. No wonder they've stagnated.
This mission takes precedence over the fate of individuals.
A krogan that responds to reason? How strange.
Only a fool accepts the word of a krogan.
The mission will succeed. The captain will not have it any other way.
We have been in difficult situations before.
The mission will succeed.
We can't let this facility continue. Our lineage still bears the scars of the last rebellion.
The krogan can't see reason.
Your actions were regrettable, but necessary.
We are all expendable for the sake of the mission.
Krogan are truly a stubborn breed.
It's rare to see a krogan accept reason. You command exceptional loyalty.
Your krogan may change his mind when he sees the extent of the facility.
We better succeed, human. We still feel the toll of the Krogan Rebellion.
The captain has never let us down.
I look forward to seeing what you humans are capable of.
This facility will be destroyed. That is our only concern.
The krogan doom themselves with their obstinance.
I've never seen a krogan negotiation end any better.
The stakes here are greater than any one individual.
Krogan persistence is remarkable. I almost admire them for it.
I'm surprised you were able to reason with a krogan.
You must be very persuasive to change the krogan's mind.
The upcoming battle frightens me, but I know Saren must be stopped.
These salarians are willing to die to stop Saren... and so am I.
I will fight with fire for you, Commander.
I am ready at your word, Commander Shepard.
The krogan seems very upset.
No matter the cost, I will not fail you, Commander.
Wrex's mood has changed since you spoke with him.
We will miss the krogan's strength. But I sense the team is better off now that he is gone.
I am sensing that Wrex no longer trusts us.
Saren will be well protected. I hope we can find a way past his defenses.
We are not a mistake!
Shall I arrange for a Council-sponsored service? Or should we dump his body in the swamps?
You have a strange code of honor, Commander Shepard. But I will see the arrangements are made, assuming we survive the assault on Saren's base.
I'll have my men drag his corpse to the swamps later, assuming we survive the assault on Saren's base.
Of sorts. We can convert our ship's drive system into a twenty-kiloton ordnance. Crude, but effective.
Are you ready, Commander?
We couldn't understand your transmission. They sent me to investigate.
The geth are bad enough. But a krogan army... he'd be almost unstoppable.
We couldn't have gotten this far without him. We owe him a decent burial.
He betrayed me. Leave his body here to rot.
You all know the mission and what is at stake. I have come to trust each of you with my life, but I have also heard murmurs of discontent. I share your concerns.
We are trained for espionage. We would be legends, but the records are sealed. Glory in battle is not our way.
Think of our heroes: the Silent Step, who defeated a nation with a single shot. Or the Ever Alert, who kept armies at bay with hidden facts.
These giants do not seem to give us solace here, but they are not all that we are. Before the network, there was the fleet. Before diplomacy, there were soldiers.
Our influence stopped the rachni, but before that, we held the line. Our influence stopped the krogan, but before that, we held the line!
Our influence will stop Saren! In the battle today, we will hold the line!
The message was unclear.
Things just get worse.
He deserves respect.
Dump him.
I will have the ordnance loaded onto the Normandy and brief your crew on its detonation sequencing.
We will engage the geth as long as possible. Once the bomb is in place, we will fall back to try and escape the blast radius.
If we move quickly, we should be able to escape with acceptable casualties. If not, then our memories will live on as martyrs to a greater cause.
The Normandy's picking me up. How will your teams escape the blast?
I need a few more moments to prepare.
Salarian exit plan
I'm not ready yet.
Aegohr, Mannovai, and Jaeto. They were the initial settlements on our first three colony worlds. They are at the heart of salarian territory to this day.
These names will remind my men what they are fighting for. They must have a personal stake in the fight if we are to have any chance of success.
Shadow seems clear enough. What will the other teams be called?
Other teams
I understand, but this mission is too important for personal preferences to get in the way.
He's right, Commander. We can't do this without both teams at their best. I volunteer.
Not so fast, LT. Commander Shepard will need you to arm the nuke. I'll go with the salarians.
With all due respect, Gunnery Chief, it's not your place to decide.
Why is it that whenever someone says "with all due respect" they really mean "kiss my ass?"
Either of these two will do, Commander. Both seem willing to sacrifice their lives if necessary, though if we are lucky, such sacrifices won't be required.
We are all soldiers by trade. If your people are not prepared to face such a risk, would you really want them by your side?
I don't make a habit of placing my people under someone else's command.
This is my decision, not yours!
You expect me to commit one of my people to your command?
Forget it.
That's a bold request.
Shut it, marines!
You are team "Shadow". We will create a distraction while you infiltrate the base. Make your way to the breeding grounds at the heart of the facility.
Disable the AA guns so the Normandy can land and deliver the nuke. If we get that far, we'll try to help you with guns, but don't count on it.
Aye, aye, Commander!
Aye, aye, Commander!
Give me a quick rundown of the plan again.
Williams, you'll accompany the captain. No heroics, understood?
Alenko, you're with the captain. Keep it simple, understood?
Recap the mission.
Take Ashley.
Take Kaidan.
I'm all you get.
Good luck, Commander. I hope we will meet again.
I volunteer, Commander.
Do you have any questions before we go, Commander?
I won't lie to you, Commander. There is a chance none of us will survive this assault. Even your team. But we do what is necessary.
We'll need someone who knows Alliance communication protocols.
Who would be better suited to the mission?
You talk like this is a suicide mission.
Let's do this.
Good idea.
Captain, who do you need?
I'm ready!
Sounds dangerous.
He was my friend.
Stay put until we can come up with a plan.
Sorry, they're not coming.
So what are we supposed to do now?
I'm Captain Kirrahe, Third Infiltration Regiment STG.
You and your crew have just landed in the middle of a hotzone. Every AA gun within ten miles has been alerted to your presence.
That is a repetition of our task.
I lost half my men investigating this place.
So what have you found?
Saren's base of operations. He's set up a research facility here, but it's crawling with geth and very well fortified.
No. But his geth are everywhere, and we've intercepted some comms referring to Saren.
This is his facility, there's no doubt about that.
He's using the facility to breed an army of krogan.
How is that possible?
Really? I didn't think krogan could breed in large numbers.
Apparently, Saren has discovered a cure for the genophage.
It was the solution to the krogan problem.
We introduced the genophage to the krogan population after the uprising. To quell their numbers.
Without it, the krogan will quickly overrun the galaxy. And these krogan follow Saren.
Exactly my thoughts. We must ensure that this facility and its secrets are destroyed.
Destroyed? I don't think so. Our people are dying. This cure can save them.
If that cure leaves this planet, the krogan will become unstoppable. We can't make the same mistake again.
Is he going to be a problem? We already have enough angry krogan to deal with.
I'd appreciate that, Commander.
I do worry. That's why I'm still alive.
Why don't you go talk to the krogan. My men and I need some time to come up with a new plan of attack.
My men and I need to rethink our plan of attack. Can you give us some time?
We won't be long, Commander.
I'm well aware of that, Commander.
In the meantime, if you need any supplies you can talk to Commander Rentola. He's in one of the tents nearby.
Looks like things are a bit of mess.
Yeah. I wouldn't be so worried if it wasn't for Wrex. He looks like he's going to blow a gasket.
It wouldn't hurt. Well, it might, actually. Just do it carefully.
I'm always ready.
If you say so. But I'm gonna keep my eye on him, if it's all the same to you.
So? Messy is our specialty. Or are you getting soft on us?
No, I've just got a bad feeling about this place.
Commander. Come and see me after you've spoken with the krogan.
I just need a few more minutes with my men.
Speak to the krogan. Settle him down. I don't want any loose cannons on this mission.
I'm just briefing my men. I suggest you do the same.
I'm sorry the krogan couldn't be reasoned with.
Thank you for speaking with the krogan. The assault on Saren's base will difficult enough as it is.
Nice. Drop that nuke from orbit and Saren can kiss his turian ass goodbye.
Unfortunately, the facility is too well-fortified for that. We'll need to place the bomb at a precise location.
The bomb must be taken to the far side of the facility.
Your ship can drop it off, but we'll need to infiltrate the base, disable the AA guns, and pacify any ground forces first.
You want us to go in on foot? We don't have enough men.
No, but I think we can work around that.
It won't be that simple. We just don't have the numbers to meet them head on.
Definitely not. But I think we can work around that.
I'm going to divide my men into three teams and hit the front of the facility.
While we've got their attention, you can sneak your "shadow" team in the back.
We're tougher than we look, Commander. But it's true. I don't expect many of us will make it out alive.
And that makes what I'm going to ask even more difficult.
I need one of your men to accompany me. To help coordinate the teams.
Well, this is it. Don't do anything stupid while I'm gone, LT. You too, Commander.
We'll be fine. You'll see.
Yeah, I just... good luck.
I don't know. It's just weird. Going under someone else's command. I've got used to working with you... all of you.
Don't worry, we'll see you on the other side.
I know. I, ah... it's been an honor serving with you, Commander.
Well, this is it. Don't do anything foolish while I'm gone, Ash. That goes for you too, Commander.
We'll be fine, LT.
Yeah, I just... good luck.
It's just weird, going under someone else's command. I've got so used to working with you... all of you.
Don't worry so much. We'll see you on the other side.
I know. I, ah... I just wanted to say it's been an honor serving with you, Commander.
You bet, Commander.
You bet, Commander.
Hooah, Commander!
Hey... look. Kirrahe's going to say something.
Hooah, Commander!
Look. Kirrahe's going to say something.
Take your time, but we're ready to go as soon as you say.
Are you in charge here? What's the situation?
Is he here? Have you seen him?
What's Saren researching?
What's so important about curing this genophage?
He'll be fine. I'll talk to him.
Don't worry about it, Captain.
Go ahead, Captain. I'll come back soon.
Don't be long, Captain. Time is not on our side.
You think I should go talk to him?
Wrex doesn't worry me. He'll fall in line.
I'll be careful. But be ready... just in case.
Just drop it. He'll be fine.
I assume that means you've come up with a plan.
Where do we take the nuke? And how do we get there?
It does sound a bit risky. Is there no other way?
Good. I prefer a straight fight anyway.
We won't be able to meet their force head on.
It's a good idea, but your people are going to get slaughtered.
I just hope you survive long enough to be useful.
Is there something you want to say, Chief?
Is there something you wanted to say, Kaidan?
It doesn't matter if we're not in the same unit, we're still a team. Watch each other's backs, keep your eyes open and fight like I know you can. We'll all come out of this in one piece.
It's a dangerous situation. Keep your eyes open and be ready for anything.
Whatever happens, everyone just keep shooting. We go in hard, hit 'em harder, and we'll be the only damn thing that comes out the other side!
I'm ready when you are, Captain.
Not yet.
What's going on?
Status?
Saren?
What kind of research?
But what's he doing?
I don't like this.
Genophage?
Damn it!
We have to stop this.
He'll listen to me.
It's okay.
Not your problem.
That's fine.
Hurry it up.
I understand.
Wrex?
Enough about Wrex.
Be ready.
I'm not scared of him.
You're right.
Assault?
Assault?
Assault?
You've got a plan.
That sounds difficult.
Where?
He's right.
I like it.
Sounds risky.
It might work.
You'll all be killed.
Works for me.
Take Kaidan.
Take Ashley.
Let's go.
What is it?
What is it?
We're a team.
Be ready.
Let's kick ass!
We stay put until the Council sends the reinforcements we requested.
We are the reinforcements.
What? You're all they sent? I told the Council to send a fleet.
That's just great. What now?
What are we supposed to do in the meantime?
Are you kidding?
Now what?
Ah, Commander. I hope you're ready for a fight. This assault isn't going to be easy.
Excellent. Then if you'll excuse me, I need to prepare my men.
Assault?
Once you have the bomb, place it next to the the geothermal taps. Then get out before it detonates.
Its reliability depends on the person arming it. But it will do the job.
The drive system is highly impervious to damage from external sources. Once it has been armed, very little can stop it.
The key is getting it into place and armed before the geth can stop us.
I want to know more about the bomb. How reliable is it going to be?
The nuke.
Greetings, human. I am Commander Rentola. I can provide you with supplies for the upcoming mission. For anything else, I suggest you speak with Captain Kirrahe.
We requested a fleet to destroy Saren's base. Instead, they sent you.
That much is clear.
Goodbye, human. Speak with the captain when you're ready to go.
What little there is.
We have limited reserves.
Hello again, human. If you need supplies, I suggest you take them now.
Your request never came through. We'll just have to make do.
I should go.
Let me see what you have.
Just tell me what you have available.
You can't have much.
The message was unclear.
Goodbye.
Show me your supplies.
Then I hope they find the sense to listen. Before it's too late.
I've been trying to warn the Council about Saren since this started.
They're fools.
Commander. Are you... all right?
What happened?
Damn. I knew he was angry; I just didn't think he'd lose his life over it.
Better him than the commander.
Yeah. I suppose.
Uh, yeah... I guess so. What happened?
Ah... sure, whatever you say.
Not today, friend.
I decided to aim. You know, since you were standing right behind him and all.
I kinda figured.
What the... did you just kill him, Chief?
Commander's orders.
Yeah, but... I just can't believe it.
I don't think so, friend.
I'm sorry, sir.
I'm sorry, ma'am.
I couldn't take the risk that he might injure you. Or worse.
Understood.
No. I'm not. I can't believe he'd turn on us.
I just couldn't reason with him. He wasn't going to let us take out the base.
He just proved to us why this place needs to be completely destroyed.
I'm feeling a hell of a lot better than he is.
I'm fine. Now let's move on.
What took you so long?
Thanks, Chief. He just wasn't going to listen to reason.
All right. We're done here.
Why the hell did you do that? I was still talking to him.
You did what you had to. I just wish I could've reasoned with him.
That's not your call. Never do that again. Understood?
Damn it.
Just fine.
Forget about it.
He snapped.
He's an animal.
About time.
Good work.
Move out!
What the hell?!
Move out!
Good work.
It had to be done.
Move out!
I'm in Command.
I don't know.
We've got a clean drop, Commander.
I know the drill. Meet you at the camp once those towers are off-line. Joker out.
We need to shut down the alarms!
We need to shut down the alarms!
We need to shut down the alarms!
We need to shut down the alarms!
We need to shut down the alarms!
Looks like an alarm hub. Think we can get some heat off us with that?
That an alarm hub? Might take the heat off.
Looks like an alarm hub over there. Might take the heat off.
Got an alarm hub or something over there, Commander. Might take the heat off.
Got an alarm hub, Commander. Think we can get some heat off us with that?
Got an alarm hub over there. Could be handy if things go south.
There's an alarm hub over here. It may be useful if we're detected.
Got an alarm hub, Commander. Might come in handy if things go south on us.
Alarm hub, Commander. Might come in handy if things go south.
There looks to be an alarm hub of sorts here. It could be useful if our situation gets messy.
The guns. Over there.
There's our target, Commander.
There's the artillery, Shepard.
I believe that is our target.
There's the artillery that's keeping the Normandy at bay.
We must find a way to disable their artillery.
There must be a way to shut that gun down.
That's a big gun. Hope we can find the off button.
There must be a way to disable that gun.
There's got to be a way to shut that thing down.
I'm reading that the grid is down, Commander. On approach to the salarian base now. Out.
Ready to move, Commander.
Ready to continue on your mark, Commander Shepard.
Ready to go, Shepard.
Ready to move on your word, Shepard.
Ready to move out, Commander.
That's the last one. We should be able to reach the salarian camp.
That did it. We shouldn't have any more trouble reaching the camp.
That was the final gate. Our path to the salarian camp should be clear from here.
That's it. We should be free to make our way to the camp.
That's it. Nothing between us and the salarian camp now.
Stay out of range and continue evasive maneuvers until I bring those AA towers down.
Keep the Normandy safe.
Good job, Joker.
Don't get cocky!
Commander. Normandy's touched down at the base, but it looks like we're grounded.
The salarian captain can explain when you get here.
There's the salarian camp.
There is the salarian camp.
There's the camp.
There go the salarians.
That must be the salarian camp.
This isn't right, Shepard. If there's a cure for the genophage, we can't destroy it.
Really? Saren created a cure for my people. You want to destroy it.
Help me out here, Shepard. The lines between friend and foe are getting a little blurry from where I stand.
Indulge me.
That's a chance we should be willing to take. This is the fate of my entire people we're talking about.
Don't push me, Shepard. I followed you because I wanted to fight for something more than credits.
I've been loyal to you so far. Hell, you did more for me than my family ever did.
But if I'm going to keep following you, I need to know we're doing it for the right reasons.
If you can't give me a better reason than this to destroy the hopes of my people, then I'm done with you.
No. We were tools for the Council once. To thank us for wiping out the rachni, they neutered us all. I doubt Saren will be as generous.
All right, Shepard. You've made your point. I don't like this, but I trust you enough to follow your lead.
Just one thing. When we find Saren, I want his head.
So that's it. All this time, and that's all I get from you?
How can you not see what this means to the krogan?
This base can't be destroyed. I won't allow it!
No more talk, Shepard. I've got to do this my way.
I understand you're upset. But we both know Saren's the enemy here. He's the one you should be angry with.
Calm down, Wrex. I'm not the enemy here. Saren's the one you should be mad at.
This has to be done. Saren's the enemy, not me.
I shouldn't have to explain that to you, Wrex.
This isn't a cure, it's a weapon. And if Saren is allowed to use it, you won't be around to reap the benefits. None of us will.
I don't care what your personal feelings are. This base gets destroyed.
Wrex, these krogan are not your people. They're slaves of Saren. Tools. Is that what you want for them?
These krogan are slaves of Saren. Puppets, tools to be used and discarded. Is that what you want for your people?
Saren doesn't care about these krogan. They're tools, puppets. He'll destroy them as soon as they're no longer useful to him. Is that what you want for your people?
All you need to know is that I'm giving you an order to fall in line.
unh
Wrex, please. We can discuss this.
hmph
I can't let you jeopardize the mission.
Easy, Wrex.
I understand.
Not my problem.
You can't be serious.
It's not that simple.
I don't have time for this!
This isn't up for debate.
I wouldn't do this otherwise.
We are.
These aren't your people!
Don't be so naive.
Don't make me choose.
This isn't up for debate.
What do you want from me?
[Shoot Wrex.]
We can work this out.
[Signal Ashley to kill Wrex.]
If we're doing this, then let's go.
I'm going to tear this place a new one.
Saren's base will be nothing but dust when I'm done.
I'm ready, Shepard. Just say the word.
You bastard.
You bitch.
Well. It's your decision, Commander.
Go on then. Don't let me get in your way.
Calm down.
